evidence.review: Search, resource type, principle controls, practical-use cards, related-directory disclosures, and phone task navigation remain readable without horizontal overflow.
Two-column resource library uses the available width and keeps filters, practical uses, source dates, and official links visible.
Comparison cards replace sideways table scrolling while preserving organization details, evidence, source links, sorting, removal, and exports.
Guided contribution controls, consent, supporting-source guidance, and review action remain usable at phone width.
Review state exposes the public submission, create-PR action, edit action, and download fallback without requiring GitHub knowledge.
